Spicy tuna tartare, crispy rice cake, furikake GF, DF, NF
Requires oven, refrigeration.
Mix Tuna with dressing, add salt if necessary and keep very cold. Heat rice cake until warm, top with 1.5tsp of tuna and top with one piece of scallion.
Peking duck, moo shu tuile DF, NF
Requires oven. Requires taco tray or smaller taco insert.
Warm duck. Mix cucumber and scallion with chiffonade mint and chiffonade cilantro. Place in bottom of tuile. Tiny squeeze of hoisin. Duck on top. Taste one for balance.
Smoked carrot tartare, parsnip purÈe, and orange gel VEGAN, GF, DF, NF
Max 300 guests!
Season the carrot with the Truffle Oil Seasoning. Start by piping 1 dot of parsnip purÈe into the carrot tartlet. Cover the parsnip purÈe with 1 tbsp of the seasoned carrot brunoise. Plate the carrot brunoise evenly over the tart shell. Pipe 4 dots of orange gel on each corner of the tart. Garnish with 3 leaves of micro parsley.
Truffled grilled cheese sandwich with celery relish V, NF
Requires oven.
Heat until cheese melts, blot as needed; garnish with small dollop of celery relish.

Spiced almonds VEGAN, GF, DF
Requires vessel and spoon.
SEATED DINNER
FIRST COURSE
Burrata, mediterranean vegetables, picholine olives, barrel aged sherry vinaigrette, charred bread V, NF
Lightly warm 2 pcs. of bread, keep warm. Drain the burrata and place onto C-folds, take off the chill, and rip one 2 oz. ball into 3 pieces (this is one portion). Chiff the basil into ¼ inch ribbons. Toss the vegetables in the dressing, add basil and season if necessary. Place the 2 pieces of bread onto a plate creating a circle, leaving some space in between them. In that space, place 1 piece of torn burrata next to each piece of bread. Sprinkle a little FDS on each piece of burrata. Spoon 2 lg. Tbsp of veggies over the bread and burrata in a circle style (be sure there is some dressing as well). Place 6-8 pieces of torn olive around the plate. Drizzle ½ Tbsp of 05X0 Noble vinegar over everything. Garnish with 4 pieces of nasturtium leaves, 2 pcs. small basil leaves & 3 pcs. small purple basil leaves.
ADDITIONAL
Artisanal breads - Passed
Butter - Placed
MAIN COURSE
3 JUNTO STAFF TO EAT WHATEVER MEALS LEFT OVER AFTER CHOICE-OF GOES OUT
CHOICE OF:
Miso glazed black cod, sea lettuce, crispy rice cake, maitake mushrooms, ginger yuzu beurre blanc GF, NF
Heat the seaweed with butter and a little bit of water, season with salt if needed. Heat the miso cod, maitake mushrooms and the crispy rice cake. Meanwhile, make the ginger yuzu beurre blanc. Place the wine reduction and heavy cream into a pot then reduce by a little more than ½. Mount in the cubed butter then season with yuzu and salt. For serve out, place a mound (about a ¼ cup) of seaweed in the center of the plate. Artfully place 2 clusters of maitakes and 3 pcs. of crispy rice around the seaweed. Place the black cod on top of the seaweed. Pour about 1 ½ oz. of ginger yuzu beurre blanc over the cod running into a pool on one side of the fish, then garnish with 2 pcs. of petite red shiso.
OR
'Classic NY Steakhouse' beef filet, creamed spinach, pomme rosti, crispy onions, cafe de Paris butter NF
OCC TO PACKAGE TO GO 1 ORDER OF STEAKHOUSE FOR CEO JIM PARSONS TO TAKE HOME
Pack large rondeau for spinach
Heat bechamel and loosen it with some milk. Sautee spinach, squeeze out water. Right before serve out, add the spinach puree, sauteed spinach, Parmesan cheese & a bit more milk to the bechamel to make a nice creamy consistency. Heat the potato rosti & the fried onions on paper towel lined sheet trays. Heat the beef tenderloin until medium rare and let rest before slicing. Slice the beef into 6 oz. medallions during serve out. Heat beef sauce. Slice cold butter into ½ inch coins, temper. Spoon 2 Tbsp of creamed spinach in the middle of the plate, using the back of a spoon to flatten and make a nice circle. Place a potato rosti on top. Place beef medallion on top of rosti. Top with 1 coin of tempered compound butter. Garnish with fried onions. Drizzle about 1 ½ Tbsp of beef sauce around the beef.
ADDITIONAL
Silent Vegetarian Option
'Classic NY Steakhouse' LION'S MANE MUSHROOM, SAUTEED spinach, pomme rosti, crispy onions GF, DF, NF, VEGAN
Prepare like the steak, subbing sauteed spinach for the creamed spinach and lion’s mane mushroom steak for the beef. Use vegan jus and vegan compound butter to finish plating.
PLATED DESSERT
CUSTOM: Plated ‘make your own’ ice cream sundae Fresh raspberries to be one of toppings Cake slice to be subbed for round glazed chocolate cake UPON REQUEST: Chef's choice flavor of sorbet for DF guests
Elite white square dinner plate 10.5", x6 tasting ceramic cube 1.5", tasting mini ceramic ramekin round ribbed low bowl for ice cream, 6 oz, tasting ceramic round bowl 2.5". Freezer.
Before serve out, fill small square cups with the 4 toppings. As it gets closer to serve out, temper the ice cream, usually 3 flavors. In the last two square cups, fill with sauces. Place all six in one corner of the square plate. Next to that, place a small circular bowl of whipped cream. Diagonal from that place the cake. Right before serve out place the ice cream in the bowl and place on the plate diagonal from toppings.
